expectation: After runs 2 and 3, I suspect flexible learned coefficients fit noise. Stronger regularization (smaller C) may improve build-household log loss. It may still fail to beat the starter, and it may not rescue history. Tune C only within each outer training set using inner household folds. This is exploratory follow-up after seeing check results, not fresh confirmation; do not evaluate the check set again.

inputs.selection_rule: Choose lowest inner-CV log loss per variant per outer fold; smaller C wins exact ties. Claim no demonstrated improvement if paired household interval includes zero.
